summary.name: WezTerm
summary.one_liner: WezTerm is a GPU-accelerated, cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer implemented in Rust, as described in a listing on this blog post page.
use_cases: running a command line shell in a fast terminal
splitting a terminal into multiple panes
finding a cross-platform terminal for macOS and Windows
summary.what_it_does: The page is a blog post titled "Wezterm" on Wez Furlong's personal site, with a link to wezterm.org for the project itself. The page text contains no feature details beyond the listing description. According to the listing, WezTerm is a GPU-accelerated, cross-platform terminal emulator and multiplexer implemented in Rust. The listing links to the project's GitHub repository and tags it as open-source and freeware. Further capabilities are not described on this page.
